skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding Basic Concepts of Agricultural Technologies
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to recognize and understand basic concepts related to agricultural technologies.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing Suitable Technologies for Crop Cultivation
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will develop the ability to analyze suitable technologies for crop cultivation and apply them effectively under real-world conditions.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Applied Technologies
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to assess the results and effectiveness of applied technologies in crop cultivation.
Students will have the capability to conduct research, analyze, and synthesize information to select appropriate technologies that enhance agricultural production efficiency.
Students will be capable of presenting logical and evidence-based arguments in the analysis and selection of agricultural technologies.
Students will be able to independently study and research to complete assigned tasks.
Students will be able to draw conclusions about issues related to the selection of agricultural technologies.
